articles.title: Why doing nothing is good for creativity
articles.summary: Modern digital distractions, such as constant scrolling and tapping, are severely impacting our creativity. Neuroscientist Dr. Nancy Andreasen's research suggests that widespread digital engagement is detrimental to fostering innovative thought. For SSB aspirants, this underscores the critical need to manage screen time effectively to cultivate sharper focus, enhance problem-solving abilities, and maintain mental resilience, essential qualities for success in defence services.

articles.title: Russia says Ukrainian drone strike kills 24 in occupied Ukraine as tensions grow amid peace talks
articles.summary: Russian officials reported a Ukrainian drone strike killed 24 and wounded 50 during New Year celebrations in a Russian-occupied Kherson village. The attack highlights ongoing intense conflict and civilian casualties in the disputed Ukrainian territories occupied by Russia, underscoring the relentless nature of the Russia-Ukraine war and its humanitarian toll.

articles.title: Yemen separatists say Saudi-backed forces to deploy in seized territories
articles.summary: Separatists within Yemen's Southern Transitional Council (STC) are actively seeking to revive the former independent state of South Yemen. This ambition significantly complicates Yemen's ongoing civil war and humanitarian crisis, presenting a major geopolitical challenge. Understanding such regional fragmentation and its international implications is vital for SSB aspirants.

articles.title: J-K: Indian Army's Romeo force intensifies search operations in Pir Panjal Ranges of Pooch amid heavy snowfall
articles.summary: The Indian Army's Romeo Force has intensified search and surveillance operations in the snow-clad Pir Panjal ranges of Poonch district, Jammu and Kashmir. Amid heavy snowfall, these proactive measures are crucial for maintaining security, preventing infiltration, and ensuring stability in the sensitive border region. This highlights the Army's unwavering commitment to operational readiness and national security in challenging conditions.

articles.title: Gaganyaan uncrewed mission, private rocket launches highlight of India's space sector in 2026
articles.summary: India is taking its first significant steps towards achieving indigenous human spaceflight with the Gaganyaan mission. Building on past space achievements, the program will commence with crucial uncrewed test flights. This initiative highlights India's growing prowess and commitment to self-reliance in advanced space technology, aiming to send Indian astronauts into orbit independently.

articles.title: DRDO successfully conducts salvo launch of two Pralay missiles in quick succession
articles.summary: DRDO, operating under the Ministry of Defence, successfully conducted a salvo launch of two advanced indigenous systems on December 31, 2025. This significant achievement underscores India's formidable progress in defence research and development, further bolstering national security and promoting self-reliance in critical weapon technologies. Aspirants should note India's continuous efforts in indigenous defence capabilities.
